"""Record the effective draft generator and its binding to tested fixtures."""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

previous=Path('/tmp/klem-present-prefinal-judgment-draft-v3.json')
inline=Path('/tmp/klem-present-prefinal-judgment-draft-v4.json')
output=Path('/tmp/klem-present-prefinal-judgment-draft-v5.json')
binding_path=Path('/tmp/klem-present-prefinal-review-source-binding.json')
assert not output.exists() and not binding_path.exists()
report=copy.deepcopy(json.loads(previous.read_text()))
for case in report['cases']:
    for judgment in case['judgments']:
        if judgment.get('required_rules')==[]:
            judgment.pop('required_rules')
report['supersedes']={'path':str(inline),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(inline.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'reason':'Record an explicit producer for omitting unused trace constraints; v4 retained its prior producer metadata after an inline transformation. No structural shape, source, or verdict changes.'}
producer=Path(__file__)
report['producer']={'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(producer.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
effective={key:report[key] for key in ['schema_version','review_status','sources']}
effective['cases']=[{key:case[key] for key in ['id','surface','judgments']} for case in report['cases']]
root=Path('/tmp/klem-present-prefinal-review')
raw_path=root/'tests/fixtures/present-prefinal-validity.json'
assert json.loads(raw_path.read_text())==effective
policy_path=root/'tests/fixtures/present-prefinal-policy.json'
policy=json.loads(policy_path.read_text())
assert policy['cases'][:-1]==effective['cases']
assert all(policy[key]==effective[key] for key in ['schema_version','review_status','sources'])
extra=policy['cases'][-1]
assert extra['surface']==report['policy_followup']['surface']=='좋는다'
assert extra['judgments'][0]['lemmas']==[report['policy_followup']['queried_predicate']]
assert extra['judgments'][0]['verdict']=='forbidden'
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
binding_path.write_text(json.dumps({'schema_version':1,'state':'passed','effective_draft_sha256':sha(output),'isolated_rust_receipt_sha256':sha('/tmp/klem-present-prefinal-review-rust.json'),'raw_fixture_sha256':sha(raw_path),'policy_fixture_sha256':sha(policy_path),'scope':'Exact binding of the authored source/whole-ending draft to the fixtures used in the passing isolated tests. This records the omission of unused trace constraints with an explicit producer; does not claim main integration or contextual certification.','producer':report['producer']},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Bound explicit effective-draft producer to the already tested raw/policy fixtures.',flush=True)
